layout.nav.label: Main
layout.lang.label: Language
layout.ethics: Only scan systems you own or have written permission to test. Unauthorized access is a crime; in Türkiye it falls under
layout.version: authdiff %s, running locally on this computer
copy.failed: Select the text and copy it manually
home.title: Find authorization bugs in your API
home.lead: authdiff sends the same requests as different users and compares the answers. A user who can read another user's order, or reach an admin endpoint, shows up as a finding.
home.demo.title: Try the demo lab
home.demo.body: A small, intentionally vulnerable API with fake users and tokens. The scan is ready to run with no setup.
home.own.title: Test your own API
home.own.body: Give a base URL and an OpenAPI spec, add one profile per user or role, review the planned requests, then scan.
home.lab.label: Demo lab status
home.lab.start_hint: Start it from the authdiff repository with one of these commands, then reload this page.
home.recent.title: Recent projects
home.recent.empty: No projects yet. Projects you set up are saved on this computer and listed here.
error.400.title: The request could not be read
error.400.body: A form field was missing or had an unexpected value. Go back and try again.
error.401.title: Open authdiff from the terminal link
error.401.body: This page needs the session link that authdiff ui printed in the terminal. Copy the full link, including ?key=, into the address bar. If you restarted authdiff ui, use the new link.
error.403.title: This action was blocked
error.403.body: The form did not come from this authdiff session, so nothing was changed. Reload the page and submit it again.
error.404.title: Page not found
error.404.body: There is nothing at this address.
error.421.title: Wrong address
error.421.body: authdiff only answers at 127.0.0.1 or localhost on the port it printed. Use the link from the terminal.
error.500.title: Something went wrong
error.500.body: authdiff hit an internal error. The details are in the terminal log.
wizard.steps.label: Setup steps
wizard.steps.autosave: Each step is saved when you continue. Tokens stay in memory only.
wizard.errors: Some fields need attention. Nothing was saved yet.
projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Projects are saved on this computer. Tokens are never saved; you enter them again after a restart, or set them as environment variables.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Set up a new one to scan your own API, or try the demo lab from the home page.
newproject.title: New project
newproject.lead: Name the project after the API or environment you will test. You can change everything else later.
newproject.name: Project name
newproject.name.help: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, for example staging-api. It is also the folder name.
newproject.err.name: Use 1 to 63 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
newproject.err.exists: A project with this name already exists. Pick another name or open the existing project.
project.title: Project
project.lead: Review the setup, continue where you left off, or go to the plan to see the requests before scanning.
project.delete.title: Delete this project
project.delete.body: Removes the project settings, the uploaded spec and every saved scan result from this computer. This cannot be undone.
project.delete.sure: I want to delete this project and its scan results
project.delete.confirm: Delete project %s and all its scan results? This cannot be undone.
project.err.sure: Tick the box to confirm the deletion.
target.lead: Tell authdiff which API to test and where its OpenAPI description is. Requests only go to the hosts listed here.
target.base.label: Base URL
target.base.help: The address requests are sent to, with http:// or https://. Do not put a user name or password in it; add them as a profile.
target.spec.help: Upload the file, or give a URL authdiff downloads it from.
target.spec.current: Saved file: %s. Upload a new one to replace it, or leave both fields empty to keep it.
target.spec.url.help: Downloaded through the same scope checks as the scan, so its host must be in the allowed hosts.
target.hosts.label: Allowed hosts
target.hosts.help: One host:port per line. Left empty, the base URL's host is used. Requests to any other host are blocked.
target.ack.title: Permission to test
target.ack.body: authdiff sends real requests with every profile's credentials. Scan only systems you own or have written permission to test.
target.ack.label: I have permission to test this system: I own it, or I have written permission.
target.err.url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address with a host name.
target.err.userinfo: Remove the user name and password from the address. Add credentials as a profile instead.
target.err.host: Each allowed host must be host or host:port, without a path.
target.err.host_missing: The list must include the base URL's host and port.
target.err.spec_required: Upload a spec file or enter its URL.
target.err.spec_ext: The spec file must end in .yaml, .yml or .json.
target.err.spec_size: The spec file is larger than 10 MiB.
target.err.spec_save: The spec file could not be saved. The details are in the terminal log.
target.err.spec_host: The spec URL's host is not in the allowed hosts. Add it to the list, or upload the file.
target.err.ack: Confirm that you have permission to test this system.
endpoints.lead: These are the operations in the spec. Untick the ones authdiff should leave alone; they are skipped in every scan of this project.
endpoints.caption: Endpoints in the spec
endpoints.tags.help: Leave all unticked to scan every selected endpoint. Ticked tags keep only endpoints that carry at least one of them.
endpoints.err.no_target: Finish the target step first: base URL, spec and the permission confirmation.
endpoints.err.load: The spec could not be loaded:
endpoints.err.load_hint: Check the file or URL on the target step. Secrets in the URL are hidden here.
profiles.lead: Add one profile per user or role you can log in as. authdiff sends the same request as each profile and compares the answers.
profiles.template.body: Starting out? Add an admin, two users and an anonymous profile in one go, then fill in their tokens.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.name.help: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, for example alice. Leave empty to skip this card.
profiles.token.help: Bearer token, cookie value or API key. Kept in memory only, never saved to disk.
profiles.auth_name.help: For an API key, the header or query name (X-API-Key by default). For a cookie, its name; leave empty if the token is the whole Cookie header.
profiles.username.help: For basic sign-in. Kept in memory only.
profiles.password.help: For basic sign-in. Kept in memory only.
profiles.secret.saved: In memory: %s. Leave empty to keep it.
profiles.owns.help: IDs of objects this profile owns, separated by commas. authdiff asks for them as other profiles to find access to someone else's data.
profiles.identifiers.help: Values that identify this user in responses, such as an email address, separated by commas.
profiles.warn.same_role: BOLA tests need two users with the same role, for example two user profiles. You can continue, but those checks will not run.
profiles.warn.missing: These profiles have no credential in memory or in their environment variable yet:
profiles.warn.missing_hint: Enter them below before scanning. After a restart of authdiff ui they have to be entered again.
profiles.err.name: Use 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
profiles.err.duplicate: Another profile already has this name.
profiles.err.auth: Pick one of the listed sign-in types.
profiles.err.owns_param: Use a parameter name such as orderId: letters, digits, _ . and -.
profiles.err.env: Two profiles would share an environment variable name. Rename one of them.
settings.lead: Pace the scan so it does not overload the target, and decide whether authdiff may send requests that change data.
settings.rate.help: Across all profiles. 5 is gentle on most staging systems.
settings.concurrency.help: At most this many requests are open at once.
settings.timeout.help: A request that takes longer counts as an error.
settings.destructive.body: With destructive mode on, authdiff also sends POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE requests as other users. Real data can be changed or deleted.
settings.destructive.demo: In the demo lab this changes the lab's data. Restart the lab afterwards to get the original data back.
settings.destructive.label: Also find write bugs (send requests that change data)
settings.destructive.on: Destructive mode is on. Untick the box to go back to safe mode.
settings.confirm.label: Type anladım or I understand to turn it on
settings.confirm.help: Required each time destructive mode is turned on.
settings.dialog.title: Turn on destructive mode?
settings.threshold.help: How alike two answers must be to count as the same data, from 0.01 to 1. Empty means 0.85.
settings.proxy.help: Send requests through an http, https or socks5 proxy, such as Burp. Empty means a direct connection.
settings.ignore.help: JSON paths such as $.requestId, one per line. Use it for values that change on every answer.
settings.insecure.warn: Only for test systems with self-signed certificates. Anyone on the network path could read or change the traffic, tokens included.
settings.matrix.help: Optional. Write an endpoint pattern such as GET /admin/** and tick who may call it: a role, owner (the object's owner) or a profile. authdiff reports any other caller that gets through.
settings.err.rate: Enter a number above 0 and at most 1000.
settings.err.concurrency: Enter a whole number from 1 to 64.
settings.err.timeout: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to 600.
settings.err.threshold: Enter a number above 0 and at most 1, or leave it empty.
settings.err.proxy: Enter an http://, https:// or socks5:// address with a host.
settings.err.proxy_userinfo: Remove the user name and password from the proxy address.
settings.err.confirm: Type anladım or I understand to turn on destructive mode. It stays off until then.
settings.err.matrix: Write a path starting with /, optionally after a method: GET /admin/**.
error.409.title: A scan is already running
error.409.body: authdiff runs one scan at a time. Wait for the running scan to finish or stop it, then start this one.
plan.title: Plan
plan.lead: These are the requests the scan would send, grouped by rule. Nothing has been sent to the target yet.
plan.err.invalid: There is no plan yet: the project settings are incomplete or the API description could not be loaded. Fix the target step and try again.
plan.missing: These profiles have no credential yet. You can review the plan, but the scan needs them:
plan.eta.hint: An estimate: ID harvesting and retries add requests the plan does not count.
plan.destructive.warn: Destructive mode is on: %d requests may change or delete data on the target.
plan.empty: The plan is empty: no rule applies to the selected endpoints and profiles. Check the endpoints and profiles steps.
run.title: Scan
run.status.stopped: Stopped. Partial results were saved. Opening them…
run.status.failed: The scan ended early on an error. Partial results were saved:
run.status.lost: The live connection was lost. Reload the page to see the current state.
run.phase.label: Phase:
run.planned.hint: The planned count is an estimate; ID harvesting and retries can send more. The bar reaches 100% only when the scan has finished.
run.stop.hint: Stopping keeps the results gathered so far.
run.preliminary.hint: Shown as they are found. The final list, merged and sorted, is on the results page.
plan.destructive.safe: Safe mode: the %d requests marked destructive are blocked before they leave authdiff and count as blocked.
results.title: Scan results
results.export.title: Download
results.export.hint: The files as they were written when this scan finished. The project zip holds the settings to run the same scan with the CLI, for example in CI.
results.matrix.hint: Each cell is the answer one profile got from one endpoint. Highlighted cells are access the profile should not have had.
results.matrix.empty: No matrix data was recorded for this scan.
results.none: No active findings in this scan.
results.suppressed.hint: Listed in the project's .authdiff-ignore. They are not counted above and stay suppressed in later scans.
finding.title: Finding
finding.evidence.hint: Requests and responses as authdiff sent and received them. Tokens and other secrets are masked.
finding.evidence.none: This finding has no recorded requests.
finding.cut: Showing the first %d KiB. The full body is in results.json.
finding.truncated: authdiff stored only part of this response.
finding.triage.title: Mark as false positive
finding.triage.body: Adds this finding's ID and your reason to the project's .authdiff-ignore. The finding moves to the suppressed list and stays suppressed in later scans.
finding.reason.help: For example: the test accounts share this data by design.
finding.err.reason: Write why this is a false positive.
project.history.empty: No scans yet. Review the plan and start the first scan.
project.running: A scan of this project is running.
project.export.err: This project cannot be exported yet. Finish the setup steps first.
